biotools.summary: gMCSpy is a Python package designed to efficiently calculate genetic Minimal Cut Sets (gMCSs) in genome-scale metabolic models (GEMs), utilizing both commercial and open-source optimization solvers. It outperforms previous tools and offers improvements in accuracy and computation time.
